references.text: The same procedure was used for blasphemy: the congregation was to take the sinner outside the camp and stone him to death.
The Israelites carried out stoning outside the camp by the Lord's command, as in the case of the Sabbath-breaker.
The basis for the death penalty: whoever desecrates the Sabbath shall die and be cut off from the people.
The Sabbath commandment with the death penalty for anyone who works on the Sabbath.
The law requires that execution by stoning must take place outside the city gate.
Achan was stoned by all Israel as punishment for his sin, an example of the community carrying out a death sentence.
Reference to the fact that whoever rejected the Mosaic Law died without mercy on the word of two or three witnesses.
